signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.resetSent: If an account exists, we've sent a link.
signIn.resetRateLimited: Too many reset requests today. Please try again tomorrow.

inApp.title: Open this page in Chrome or Safari
inApp.body: Google sign-in doesn't work inside Facebook, Messenger or Instagram. Copy the link and open it in Chrome or Safari, or sign in with email below.
inApp.copyFailed: Could not copy. Copy the address from the menu instead.

errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.generic: Could not log in. Please try again.

report.prompt: See a fake or duplicate school?
report.title: Report a school
report.subtitle: The Sathiya team will review it. The school isn't told who reported it.
report.email: Your email (optional, so we can reply)
report.error: Could not send the report. Please try again.
report.rateLimited: Too many reports. Please try again later.

errors.badRequest: This link is not valid. Open the link from your email again.
errors.expired: This link has expired. Request a new email and try again.
errors.invalid: This link has already been used or is not valid. Request a new email and try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

verify.title: Email confirmed
verify.body: Your email address is confirmed. You can continue setting up your school.
verify.bodyBack: Your email address is confirmed. You can go back to where you left off.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.doneBody: Your password has been changed. Log in with your new password.

recover.title: Email restored
recover.body: Your email address has been changed back to {{email}}. If you didn't ask for the change, reset your password too.

start.title: Get started
start.subtitle: You're signed in but not part of a school yet.
start.registerBody: Set up your school's timetable. You become its admin.
start.joinBody: Paste the link your school admin sent you.
start.joinInvalid: That doesn't look like a Sathiya invite link.

signUp.failed: Could not create the account. Please try again.
